result.title: DeBoneDiT: Depth-Driven Conditional Bridge Diffusion Transformers for Bone Suppression in Chest X-Ray Images
result.summary: Chest X-Ray (CXR) is a primary modality for diagnosing pulmonary diseases, yet the overlap of bony structures often obscures critical radiographic findings, increasing the risk of diagnostic uncertainty. While Dual-Energy Subtraction (DES) is the clinical benchmark for bone suppression, its widespread adoption is primarily hindered by specialized hardware requirements and increased radiation exposure. Recently, diffusion-based generative models have shown promise for this task, yet they are still constrained by reconstruction-biased latent compression, prior-induced domain gap, and a scarcity of high-quality paired datasets. To address these challenges, we propose DeBoneDiT, a depth-driven conditional bridge diffusion Transformer architecture for efficient high-resolution bone suppression. We first introduce Depth Auto-Encoder (DAE), a structure-aware vision tokenizer for latent compression. By incorporating a multi-level depth feature loss derived from the pretrained Depth Anything V2 encoder, DAE preserves both visual fidelity and structural consistency. Second, we formulate bone suppression as a source-conditioned Brownian bridge diffusion process, leveraging CXRs as both the diffusion prior and structural guidance to narrow the source-to-target domain gap and maintain anatomical plausibility. Furthermore, we have constructed and released SZCH-X-Rays, the largest publicly available high-quality paired dataset for bone suppression to date, comprising 741 pairs of CXR and DES soft tissue images. Extensive experiments and downstream evaluation demonstrate that DeBoneDiT achieves superior bone suppression performance with reduced computational overhead.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 DeBoneDiT，用深度驱动的条件桥扩散 Transformer 做胸片骨抑制：以 Depth Anything V2 特征的多层级深度损失训练结构感知分词器（DAE）做潜空间压缩，并把任务建模为源条件布朗桥扩散，另发布 741 对配对数据集。
AI.relevance_reason: 论文把「重构图生偏置的潜压缩」与结构信息丢失列为瓶颈，并用深度损失约束分词器保留解剖结构，这可能为 LVR 中视觉细节是否保留在内部状态、潜表示坍缩等问题提供可核查的表示侧线索；但任务属图像翻译而非推理，联系需较多核查。
